traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Limit meets power. Hard discipline, endurance under heavy pressure, real consequences, and control. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Capacity for grueling, sustained, transformative effort. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize limit and power into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what limit and power have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
shadow: The ease lets fear and rigidity and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: If the same conflict keeps returning with different people, the pattern is probably being protected by something larger than the latest person causing the problem.
readerCopy.body: If the same conflict keeps returning with different people, the pattern is probably being protected by something larger than the latest person causing the problem. When Saturn sextiles Pluto, you have an opportunity to change the boundary, responsibility, access, or decision-making process that keeps allowing the same dynamic to recreate itself. Replacing one person may bring temporary relief, but it will not protect you from the next version of the problem if the setup stays the same. Use the opening to change what people are allowed to do, who gets the final say, or what happens when the boundary is crossed.
